Hi Erin — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to help and to get you what you need before your 11/30 deadline. Summary below, plus attached artifacts you can download immediately.

1) Report availability
- We have a finalized SOC 2 Type II report for the period Jan 1 – Jun 30, 2026. I have attached the redacted report (PDF) for your review. If you need the full unredacted report, we can provide it under an NDA — let me know.

2) Bridge letters
- We can provide a bridge letter that states the control posture from the report continues through a specified date (typically up to 90 days after the report period). Draft bridge-letter sample attached (bridge-letter-sample.docx). If you request an extension to Aug 31, 2026, we can provide a bridge letter covering that window.

3) Minimal evidence checklist and intake items
- Attached: type2-evidence-minimal-checklist.pdf — this is a short list we recommend for initial triage (log retention proof, access control screenshots, change management summary, encryption key management statement). If you need an expanded artifact set we can follow up.

4) Transfer options (what we support)
- Encrypted SFTP (preferred for larger bundles) — we can provide user accounts and rotate keys on delivery.
- Presigned S3 objects (time-limited links) — easiest for ad-hoc single-file transfers.
- Secure API push (SFTP/S3 backed) — available for integrations; requires a short onboarding call to exchange certs.

Our recommendation: for a one-off report + minimal artifacts, presigned S3 links or a secure Drive share are the fastest. For continued evidence exchange (multiple files, logs), SFTP or API is better. Instructions attached (transfer-options-instructions.txt).

Next steps
- Please confirm: (A) whether you want the full unredacted report (NDA required) or the redacted version we attached, and (B) preferred transfer method (SFTP / presigned S3 / API).
- If bridge letter is needed, confirm the target coverage date (e.g., Aug 31).
